summary: All 13 records were checked. Infectum-wa grukxowa describes the cheese-softening process; Preterit-wa rakixowa in the following verse presents achieved softness anterior to pressing. Both are already in the entry and are not re-added.

Part act. rakixo can be predicative with a copula, attributive to cotton, and part of a coordinated property description. Feminine rakәxto is retained in this inherited category. These static forms must not be classified as Preterit from the English or German tense alone.
The inherited wording “would be great to know why the [k] is plosive” is preserved as a question. The orphan “Preterit Intransitive” is structural metadata, not a newly attested finite example.
